definition: Tone and style of section titles and headings.

name: notice_phrasing
definition: How operational notices (closures, delays, alerts) are worded.

name: numeric_detail_in_descriptions
definition: Whether descriptive text carries concrete numbers or quantitative facts.

name: personal_sign_off
definition: Whether a message ends with a personal signature or sign-off.

name: variant_labeling
definition: How paired or variant entries are distinguished in labels.

name: price_format
definition: Pattern of displayed price endings.

name: metric_values_shown
definition: Whether displayed metrics include placeholder-like zero or empty values.

name: content image alt text
definition: How alt text is provided for content images, including card images and video thumbnails (not logos).

values.definition: Content images use empty alt attributes.
Content images have meaningful descriptive alt text.
Alt text is generic or follows a repeated pattern.
Alt treatment differs depending on image role.
No alt treatment is stated or present.

name: logo alt text treatment
definition: How the logo image's alt attribute is set.

name: alt attribute coverage
definition: Whether every image has an alt attribute present (even if empty).

values.definition: Every image has an alt attribute.

name: ARIA attribute usage
definition: Presence of ARIA attributes for accessibility.

name: accessibility aids or trust seals
definition: Presence of explicit accessibility aids or trust seals.

name: semantic landmark usage
definition: Whether the page uses HTML5 landmark elements (header, nav, main, footer, section) rather than generic containers.

name: secondary semantic element usage
definition: Whether article, aside and figure elements are used (including on cards).

values.definition: Article, aside and/or figure are used.

name: navigation and footer list markup
definition: Whether navigation and footer links are marked up as ul/li lists.

name: hidden login modal in DOM
definition: Whether markup includes a hidden modal dialog, and whether it contains a form.

name: h1 presence and count
definition: Whether the page has a single H1 as top-level heading, or lacks one.

name: heading level ordering
definition: Whether heading levels follow a logical sequential order.

values.definition: Levels appear out of order in the DOM.

name: heading depth
definition: How many distinct heading levels the page uses.

name: repeated item and footer heading level
definition: Heading level used for footer column titles or titles of repeated content items.

name: CSS class naming approach
definition: Whether class names come from a utility framework or hand-written semantic/custom vocabulary.

values.definition: Small custom or semantic class names.

values.value: little or none or not stated
values.definition: Few or no classes, or not stated.

name: class usage density
definition: How many class names are applied across the markup.

name: inline style attributes
definition: Whether styling is applied via inline style attributes.

name: testimonial and quote markup
definition: HTML elements used to mark up testimonials and quotations.

values.definition: Divs or other markup, or none present.

name: markup authoring style
definition: How HTML is authored regarding class naming and line-break handling.

values.value: sparse classes with manual br breaks

name: head meta richness
definition: How much metadata the document head carries.

name: structured data
definition: Presence of structured data (JSON-LD, microdata).

name: contact markup element
definition: Which HTML element marks up contact details.

name: logo content type
definition: Whether logos are images, text, or mixed, and how they are labeled.

values.definition: Mix of image and text logos.

name: interactive control element type
definition: HTML element used for calls to action and clickable interactive controls.

values.definition: Other, not present or not specified.

name: repeated item container element
definition: Which HTML element wraps each repeated content item.

name: date markup
definition: How dates or timestamps are marked up.

name: stylesheet delivery
definition: Where the page's CSS lives and how it is delivered.

name: icon delivery format
definition: How icons are implemented.

name: JavaScript usage
definition: Whether and how much JavaScript the page ships.

values.definition: The page includes a small amount of JavaScript.
The page ships JavaScript, with the amount unspecified.

name: Band role
definition: Purpose of the full-width band.

values.definition: Band promotes an offer or call to action.
Band structures or separates page sections.

name: CSS class approach
definition: Naming and organization approach of the CSS classes.

values.definition: A small set of hand-named semantic classes.
